decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - A scheme of phasing of development shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Royal Mail Delivery Office / Open Space

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 7 - 8.	A green travel plan for employees of and visitors to the Royal Mail Delivery Office shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing prior to commencement of development on site, and the means of travel for deliveries and journeys to work shall be in accordance with the approved green travel plan, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

Condition : 8 - No development of the Royal Mail Delivery Office shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 9 - The use as a Royal Mail Delivery Office hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 10 - The use hereby permitted for a Royal Mail Delivery Office shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works both around the Royal Mail Delivery Office building and on the former allotment site have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture,  refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc; 

Soft landscape works shall include planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme

Condition : 12 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 13 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected around the Royal Mail Delivery Office, including details of acoustic fencing.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the building is occupied.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 14 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected around the site of the former allotment site.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the use of the building as a Royal Mail Delivery Office hereby permitted is commenced or in accordance with a timetable to be agreed with the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 15 - Unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority, no part of the development shall be occupied until the works for the improvement of the access arrangements at the junctions of Staines Road and the entrance to Central Park Estate have been completed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 16 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 1115.3L received 7.7.03 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 17 - Development shall not commence until a survey of the existing ground levels has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 18 - 19.	The ground levels shall not be raised or otherwise altered from those shown on the submitted plan, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 19 - 20.	Development shall not commence until details of sound attenuation measures, including acoustic fencing and earth bunding,  around the Royal Mail Delivery Office site have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. These shall be installed prior to first occupation of the Royal Mail Delivery Office and thereafter permanently maintained

Condition : 20 - Detailed drawings of the proposed open space, allotments, orchard and wild area (including details of footpaths, access points, construction materials, levels, seating, bins, lighting and any ancillary structures) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and then carried out and completed before the first occupation of the Royal Mail Delivery Office hereby approved. Development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 21 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 22 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 23 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.
Condition : 24 - Clements Court Improvements

Condition : 25 - The use of a Royal Mail Delivery Office hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the Royal Mail Delivery Office hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 26 - The use hereby permitted for a community hall shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 27 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works around Clements Court Estate have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc)

Soft landscape works shall include planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme

Condition : 28 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 29 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 1115.3L received 7.7.03 and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 30 - Detailed drawings of the ball cage / kickabout area to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. These shall include details of siting, fencing, surfacing, floodlighting, and hours of operation. The development shall not be carried otherwise than in accordance with any such approval and shall be completed prior to first occupation of the Royal Mail Delivery Office hereby approved

Condition : 31 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the community hall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 32 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 33 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 34 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.

Condition : 35 - Detailed drawings of the proposed improvements to the Clements Court Housing Estate, including access arrangements, surface parking, refuse and recycling stores and community hall shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and then carried out and completed before the first occupation of the Royal Mail Delivery Office hereby approved. Development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 36 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the flats at Clements Court from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before first occupation of the Royal Mail Delivery Office
description: Erection of new  Royal Mail delivery offices, reinstatement of allotments, removal of existing decked car parks,  formation of replacement surface car parks, erection of community building and refuse stores, together with general landscaping and including improvements to the Staines Road and Green Lane accesses.
